dataset.kind: Checked-in synthetic smoke texts; not original Seed test-en recordings.

protocol.request_order: 30 texts cyclically repeated ten times; complete request bodies match across arms, repeated rounds and client concurrency.
protocol.seed: 42 + zero-based request index; resets for each cohort.
protocol.warmup: Fresh server per arm. Before timing: 150 requests each in sampled C32, capped-greedy C32, sampled C64, capped-greedy C64 order; 600 excluded warmup requests per arm.
protocol.cohort_order: Round 0: sampled C32, greedy C32, sampled C64, greedy C64. Rotate left one position in round 1 and two in round 2.
protocol.arms_order: All baseline rounds and C1 control precede candidate validation, final rounds and final C1 control; arms are sequential, not interleaved.
protocol.timing: Request start through complete PCM receipt. Cohort wall is latest response end minus earliest request start. PCM joining, analysis, hashing and writes follow completion of all cohort requests.
protocol.profiling: Both timing arms uninjected; separate profiles excluded.
protocol.asr: No ASR during timing arms; quality work follows both servers stopping.
protocol.memory_polling: Identical 1 Hz management polling in both arms; whole-run scope stated separately.
protocol.source_guards: Six identical execution helpers and full source/config/model/runtime/GPU checks; final timing bound to the exact successful 50-test candidate.

workload_scope.texts: 30 synthetic English smoke texts; not original Seed-TTS or a published blog benchmark.
workload_scope.startup_and_warmup: Server startup and all four warmup waves are excluded from measured makespans.

metric_definitions.rtf: Cohort makespan / total full returned PCM duration, including quiet tails.
metric_definitions.p95_response_s: Per-cohort statistics.quantiles(request wall seconds,n=20,method="inclusive")[18]. Summary is median/minimum/maximum of three cohort p95s.
metric_definitions.summary: Three per-cohort observations per arm/family: median and observed full min/max ranges, no confidence intervals.
metric_definitions.total_audio_percent_change: Change in SUMMED audio duration across all three rounds: 900 responses per arm/family.
metric_definitions.near_cap: PCM-derived frames >= max_new_tokens-1; exact-cap counts reported separately.
metric_definitions.frames: PCM byte length /3840 (1920 mono int16 samples/frame). No RVQ token sequence recorded.
metric_definitions.interior: Last initial request start through last request start; counts completions and their full delivered clips. This is not GPU work isolated to the window.

memory.scope: 1 Hz whole-GPU resident memory across startup, four warmups, all measured rounds, post-timing C1 control, and shutdown; not peak allocated memory and not a measured-window-only peak.
memory.interpretation: These are observed whole-run sampled resident maxima, including startup and warmup. The difference is not attributed to memory savings from the optimization.

c1_control.note: Frame counts are derived from PCM length; no RVQ token sequence was recorded. Recorded hashes are distinguished from downloaded WAV verification. Excluded from throughput.
c1_control.position: 60 sampled requests at concurrency one after measured rounds per arm; excluded from throughput.
c1_control.waveform_verification_status: All 120 saved C1 WAV payloads were independently decoded and checked locally against their recorded PCM hashes; all 60 cross-arm request bodies, PCM-derived frame counts and PCM hashes match.
c1_control.quality_caveat: Byte-identical output is not necessarily correct speech: one matched control pair has a severe ASR mismatch in the targeted follow-up.

quality_observations.status: Endpoint, C1 and selected ASR checks completed; severe ASR mismatches confirmed in baseline and final outputs.
quality_observations.caveat: The final C64 14.0-second output has 27 normalized word edits against 13 reference words. Same-input/seed checks also find severe baseline mismatches and a mismatched byte-identical C1 pair. The final C32 25.84-second output transcribes expected words, but its excess duration remains unexplained. These selected checks establish neither quality equivalence nor a change in failure rates.

current_outlier_ASR.finding: Expected words transcribed; large duration anomaly remains unresolved.
ASR transcribed unrelated content; serious content mismatch.

quality_observations.controlled_same_input_seed_followup: Complete 13-membership diagnostic: severe baseline mismatches and a mismatched byte-identical C1 pair confirm the issue predates the candidate relative to this baseline. Failure-rate changes and quality equivalence remain unproven.

limitations: Three observed rounds per arm; medians and full min/max ranges, no confidence intervals or statistical significance claim.
Arms ran sequentially in one allocation, each with a fresh server and identical four-wave warmup; temporal effects remain possible.
Greedy48 is a capped greedy workload; early EOS prevents a fixed-work claim whenever all_fixed48_valid is false.
Natural output duration and caps affect wall/audio RTF. ASR and quiet-tail validation are separate evidence; no quality equivalence inferred here.
Interior completion rates omit ramp-up/drain but include whole delivered clips crossing window boundaries; not a GPU-work measure.

Greedy median throughput changes only +0.02% at C32 and +0.83% at C64; ranges overlap. C32 median per-cohort p95 response increases. The 48-token cap permits early EOS and is not a fixed-work control.
Gains are incremental versus the stated baseline only; no multiplication by historical gains.
C1 recorded hash equality does not establish bitwise concurrent trajectory equality or perceptual quality.
Whole-run sampled resident memory maxima are not peak allocator usage or measured-window-only peaks.

Performance evidence covers guidance scale 1, no reference audio, and 30 synthetic English smoke texts only. It establishes no new voice-cloning, higher-guidance, long-prompt or multi-GPU performance claim.
Startup and warmup are excluded from throughput timing; no cold-start improvement is claimed.

Severe ASR mismatches occur in both baseline and final outputs, including one byte-identical C1 pair. This confirms a pre-existing baseline problem but establishes neither failure-rate changes, quality equivalence nor causal attribution. The final C32 duration anomaly remains unexplained.

endpoint_quality.method: 20ms endpoint RMS windows <= -40dBFS; internal pauses retained; WAVs unchanged; trimmed RTF is a diagnostic sensitivity check, not speech detection or a replacement timing metric.

asr_validation.primary_selection: One upper-duration-median clip per each of 30 prompts in round 0 sampled C32, each arm.
asr_validation.normalization: NFKC, case folding, non-letter/non-number separators; no numeric word expansion.
limitations: A targeted transcription sanity check of selected clips, not a full-corpus ASR score, perceptual-quality evaluation or MOS.
Numeric spelling and recognition differences contribute to normalized word edits.
No quality-improvement or concurrent-output equivalence claim.

supplemental_current_outliers.finding: Expected words transcribed; large duration anomaly remains unresolved.
ASR transcribed unrelated content; serious content mismatch.

asr_validation.same_input_seed_followup_status: Complete; severe baseline and final ASR mismatches confirmed. Failure rates and quality equivalence remain unproven.

same_input_seed_followup.scope: Only the 12 sampled cohorts and C1 controls of this matched comparison; final means candidate commit ca22df8b3a6459154271873006caaebc829ec5a9.
same_input_seed_followup.input_text: Our quarterly engineering review begins promptly at two in the afternoon on Thursday.
same_input_seed_followup.selection: Post-hoc follow-up of a problematic input/seed across both arms, all rounds and both client concurrency levels, plus one representative of its byte-identical C1 pair.

findings: Severe ASR mismatches occur in baseline outputs, including 16 and 149 word edits over 13 reference words. The issue predates this candidate relative to the stated baseline.
The byte-identical baseline/final C1 representative has 26 word edits over 13 reference words: bitwise agreement does not establish correct speech content.
Final concurrent outputs also show serious ASR mismatches; the previously observed C32 duration anomaly remains unexplained.
limitations: This selected diagnostic cannot estimate failure rates, establish quality equivalence, or attribute changes causally to batching or the optimization.
ASR can introduce recognition errors and repetitions; these are transcription sanity findings, not perceptual-quality scores or MOS.
The frozen 60-clip primary sample and this targeted diagnostic remain separate.

method.configuration: Same model, deployment and workload as the uninjected comparison; four matched warmups and a 300-request collection-disabled control precede each capture.

limits: One separately instrumented capture per arm; profiler overhead changes host timing.
CPU annotation spans include waiting and overlap for nested scopes; do not sum them or equate their differences with serving speedup.
External kernel records exclude graph-internal nodes. Captured sampling kernels still execute on the GPU. Replay seed/offset prologue kernels remain external.
Both stages covered on one GPU before drain. Different iteration counts are normalized by fully contained 32-request ranges.
Graph envelopes hide internal gaps. Recorded activity is an upper bound and recorded idle is a lower bound, not SM utilization. Capturing more work changes those bounds.
Faster submission moves some waiting into EOS readback; it does not remove the dependency on completed sampling.
